sloka: तथा पृष्टा यथा तत्त्वम् आख्यातुम् उपचक्रमे ।माता अस्य युगपद् वाक्यम् विप्रियम् प्रिय शन्कया ॥२-७२-४१॥
transliteration: tathā pṛṣṭā yathā tattvam ākhyātum upacakrame ।mātā asya yugapad vākyam vipriyam priya śankayā ॥2-72-41॥

translations.english: Thus questioned, his mother started relating the exact events, presuming them to be pleasant tidings (for Bharata).
